raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

GLM-5.3-Flash (`Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration`) cannot run MoRIIO hybrid READ P/D on `main`. It has two transferable attention groups (MLA + indexer, and the kpool tail ring, a `CircularBufferSpec`), KDA groups, and MTP. `main` allows one attention group and DSpark only. With the packed `UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs` layout, `main` also classifies KDA groups as attention and silently skips recurrent-state transfer.

Changes (connector-only: `moriio_connector.py`, tests, one docs line):

- Hybrid READ payload is `[*attn_groups, *mamba_groups]`, byte-identical to `main` with one attention group.
- `_align_read_blocks` runs per attention group. Non-prefix-cacheable groups are read even on a full local hit.
- Each hybrid layer is routed to its own payload group. READ destinations of all attention groups are excluded from KV zeroing.
- A group is Mamba when every layer spec it covers is a `MambaSpec`.
- READ: the DSpark-only check is replaced by "the drafter shares the target's attention groups" (MTP, DSpark). Hybrid WRITE (#60544) is unchanged, including its DSpark check.
- `CircularBufferSpec` is accepted only for hybrid READ. Non-hybrid and hybrid WRITE still fail closed (`NotImplementedError` at init).
- Usage guide: drop the single-attention-group requirement.

Scope:

- Non-hybrid models do not reach the changed code (all scheduler changes are under `_has_mamba`).
- Single-attention-group hybrid READ is covered by byte-identity unit tests only.
- Drafters with a separate attention group are out of scope.

Requires #58585 (per-layer `block_len`), merged. The branch includes `main` with #60544 (hybrid WRITE).

## Test Plan

```bash
python -m pytest -q tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_moriio_hma_scheduler.py
python -m pytest -q tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_moriio_*.py
```

Environment: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly`, MI300X.

E2E: GLM-5.3-Flash-FP8, 1P/1D, MoRIIO READ, MTP 1, EP8 per leg, KV block 8, MI300X; `main` 19b0efce30 + this PR only.

## Test Result

### Unit

- After merging `main` 5be4266f5c: `test_moriio_hma_scheduler.py` 110 passed (104 on `main`); all `test_moriio_*.py` 299 passed, 0 failed (293 on `main`).
- Two `main` tests are intentionally replaced: the multiple-attention-group rejection and the READ case of the non-DSpark rejection.
- New tests: GLM-5.3-Flash grouping with MTP, payload pairing (partial/full hit), per-layer routing, single-group byte-identity, no-attention-group gate, `CircularBufferSpec` rejection (non-hybrid, hybrid WRITE), WRITE non-DSpark rejection. The non-hybrid gate test fails on the previous head.

### E2E without this PR

All 8 engine cores per leg fail at connector init; servers never come up:

```
moriio_connector.py, line 519, in __init__
MoRIIOError: MoRIIO hybrid READ requires exactly one transferable attention group, got 2; ...
RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed.
```

Baseline below is therefore the prefill server queried directly (no KV transfer).

### E2E with this PR

Random data, 1024 output tokens, 16 requests at c=1, 32 at c=8, no failures. Cells: run 1 / run 2, different node pairs.

| ISL, concurrency | TTFT mean (ms) | TTFT P99 (ms) | TPOT mean (ms) | Output tok/s |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8K, c=1 | 1329 / 1262 | 2459 / 1943 | 9.8 / 10.0 | 90.3 / 88.9 |
| 8K, c=8 | 1720 / 1615 | 2962 / 2907 | 11.2 / 11.2 | 554 / 587 |
| 32K, c=1 | 3705 / 3626 | 3759 / 3685 | 10.4 / 10.1 | 71.5 / 73.4 |
| 32K, c=8 | 7052 / 6228 | 10915 / 10011 | 11.6 / 11.7 | 385 / 396 |
| 256K, c=1 | 31952 / 31517 | 32973 / 32512 | 8.8 / 9.3 | 25.0 / 24.9 |
| 512K, c=1 | 66391 / 65961 | 67178 / 67412 | 9.9 / 9.4 | 13.4 / 13.6 |

Run-to-run TTFT variation: 0.6–2.2% at c=1 (32K–512K), 6–12% at c=8.

| Check (run 1 / run 2) | P/D router | Prefill direct |
|---|---|---|
| GSM8K 5-shot, 1319 questions, strict | 91.21 ± 0.78 / 91.89 ± 0.75 | 92.27 ± 0.74 / 92.57 ± 0.72 |
| NIAH found/10, seeds 0/1/2, 2K / 8K / 32K words | run 1: 10,10,10 / 10,10,9 / 1,10,10; run 2: 10,10,10 / 10,10,10 / 10,9,10 | all 10 (32K: one run) |
| 16-concurrent NIAH × 3 rounds | 48/48 / 48/48 | – |
| Single needle, 243K/486K/713K tokens × 3 depths | 7/9 / 9/9 | – |
| MTP acceptance during GSM8K | 93.4% / 93.3% | 95.1% / 95.1% |

- After merging `main` 5be4266f5c (2 runs): GSM8K 90.90 ± 0.79 / 91.96 ± 0.75; 16-concurrent NIAH 48/48 both; NIAH 2K 9,10,9 / 10,10,9, 8K 10,10,10 / 8,10,10, 32K 3,10,10 / 8,10,10.
- Without the packed-Mamba classification fix, NIAH was 0/10 at 2K words for 2 of 3 seeds.

Caveats:

- GSM8K router minus prefill-direct, paired by question: -1.06 (95% CI -2.37 to +0.25) and -0.68 (95% CI -1.78 to +0.42). Both include zero.
- NIAH misses are not transfer-related: on the merged tree, 2K words × 5 seeds × 3 passes, 4/15 prefill-direct and 3/15 router requests missed a needle, and same-path reruns flip between complete and incomplete (temperature 0).
- MTP acceptance is 1.7–1.8 points lower via P/D.
- No `MoRIIOError` or tracebacks on either leg in any run.

AI assistance (Claude) was used in preparing this change.

files.patch:
@@ -142,7 +142,7 @@ WRITE mode supports hybrid attention plus Mamba/KDA models, including DSpark. Us
 
 For DSpark, configure the same draft model on both instances through `--speculative-config`. Target and draft attention groups retain their own block IDs and token spans; only the running recurrent state is transferred, not speculative scratch slots. The producer transfers the state after the first N-1 prompt tokens, and the consumer recomputes the last prompt token. Convolution and SSM transfers must both finish before the layer is complete.
 
-Hybrid READ keeps its existing single-transferable-attention-group requirement. Plain-attention WRITE retains its existing notification format.
+Hybrid READ transfers every attention group, so drafters that share the target's attention groups (such as MTP) also work. Plain-attention WRITE retains its existing notification format.
 
 ### Different prefill and decode TP sizes

@@ -10,6 +10,8 @@
 """
 
 import importlib
+import threading
+from collections import defaultdict
 from dataclasses import asdict
 from types import SimpleNamespace
 from unittest.mock import Mock
@@ -18,9 +20,19 @@
 import torch
 
 from vllm.v1.core.block_pool import BlockPool
+from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_planning import get_kv_cache_groups
 from vllm.v1.core.sched.output import KVConnectorBlockState, SchedulerOutput
 from vllm.v1.core.single_type_kv_cache_manager import FullAttentionManager
-from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import FullAttentionSpec, UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import (
+    CircularBufferSpec,
+    FullAttentionSpec,
+    KVCacheConfig,
+    KVCacheSpec,
+    MLAAttentionSpec,
+    UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_layout import KVCacheLayout
+from vllm.v1.request import RequestStatus
 
 moriio_connector = importlib.import_module(
     "vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.moriio.moriio_connector"
@@ -56,6 +68,7 @@ def __init__(self, **attrs):
         self.mode = MoRIIOMode.READ
         self._mamba_group_ids: list[int] = []
         self._attn_group_ids: list[int] = [0]
+        self._attn_group_is_state: list[bool] = [False]
         self._num_ssm_scratch_blocks = 0
         self._is_hma_required = False
         self.kv_cache_config = SimpleNamespace(
@@ -173,7 +186,7 @@ def test_split_block_groups_separates_attention_and_mamba():
     sched = _FakeScheduler(_has_mamba=True, _attn_group_ids=[0], _mamba_group_ids=[1])
     block_ids = ([1, 2], [99])
     attn, mamba = sched.split_block_groups(block_ids)
-    assert attn == [1, 2]
+    assert attn == [[1, 2]]
     assert mamba == [[99]]
 
 
@@ -210,7 +223,7 @@ def test_split_block_groups_ignores_transfer_disabled_group():
         kv_cache_config=config,
     )
     assert sched.split_block_groups(([1, 2], [70, 71], [99])) == (
-        [1, 2],
+        [[1, 2]],
         [[99]],
     )
 
@@ -232,21 +245,212 @@ def test_exchange_blocks_ignore_transfer_disabled_group():
     ]
 
 
-def test_scheduler_rejects_multiple_attention_groups_with_mamba():
-    """A drafter owning its own transfer group is refused, with a hint."""
+def test_exchange_clipped_blocks_match_select_for_single_full_attention():
+    # With blocks_per_sw == 0 the wire payload must match the pre-multigroup one.
+    def select(block_ids):
+        # Group 1 is not transfer-enabled.
+        return (block_ids[0], block_ids[2])
+
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        kv_cache_groups=[None, None, None],
+        select_transfer_block_ids=select,
+    )
+    raw = ([1, 2, 3], [70, 71], [90, 91, 92])
+
+    hma = _FakeScheduler(
+        kv_cache_config=config, _is_hma_required=True, blocks_per_sw=[0, 0]
+    )
+    plain = _FakeScheduler(kv_cache_config=config, _is_hma_required=False)
+
+    clipped = hma.get_exchange_clipped_blocks(raw)
+
+    assert clipped == [list(group) for group in select(raw)]
+    assert clipped == plain.get_exchange_clipped_blocks(raw)
+
+
+def test_scheduler_rejects_hybrid_without_attention_group():
     config = SimpleNamespace(
         kv_cache_groups=[
-            SimpleNamespace(enable_kv_transfer=True, kv_cache_spec=object()),
-            SimpleNamespace(enable_kv_transfer=True, kv_cache_spec=object()),
             SimpleNamespace(enable_kv_transfer=True, kv_cache_spec=_mamba_spec()),
         ],
     )
     config.transfer_groups = tuple(config.kv_cache_groups)
 
-    with pytest.raises(moriio_common.MoRIIOError, match="separate attention group"):
+    with pytest.raises(moriio_common.MoRIIOError, match="attention group"):
         moriio_connector.MoRIIOConnectorScheduler(_gate_vllm_config(), "engine", config)
 
 
+def _glm5_next_mtp_kv_cache_config() -> KVCacheConfig:
+    """GLM-5.3-Flash-shaped groups from the real grouping, with an MTP layer."""
+    kpool, num_spec = 4, 1
+    mamba = _mamba_spec(num_speculative_blocks=num_spec)
+    specs: dict[str, KVCacheSpec] = {}
+    for i in range(7):
+        if i % 3 != 2 and i != 6:
+            specs[f"layers.{i}.linear_attn"] = mamba
+            continue
+        specs[f"layers.{i}.attn"] = MLAAttentionSpec(
+            block_size=1024, num_kv_heads=1, head_size=576, dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        specs[f"layers.{i}.indexer"] = MLAAttentionSpec(
+            block_size=1024,
+            num_kv_heads=1,
+            head_size=132,
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            tokens_per_state=kpool,
+        )
+        specs[f"layers.{i}.tail"] = CircularBufferSpec(
+            block_size=2 * kpool,
+            num_kv_heads=2,
+            head_size=128,
+            head_size_v=0,
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            dcp_sharded=False,
+        )
+    vllm_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(disable_hybrid_kv_cache_manager=False),
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(pipeline_parallel_size=1),
+        speculative_config=None,
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            get_resolved_kv_cache_layout=lambda: KVCacheLayout.BLHNC
+        ),
+    )
+    groups = get_kv_cache_groups(vllm_config, specs)
+    return KVCacheConfig(num_blocks=64, kv_cache_tensors=[], kv_cache_groups=groups)
+
+
+def _glm5_next_mtp_scheduler(kv_role: str = "kv_consumer"):
+    vllm_config = _gate_vllm_config(
+        speculative_config=_spec_config("mtp"),
+        block_size=1024,
+        num_lookahead_tokens=1,
+        num_speculative_tokens=1,
+    )
+    vllm_config.kv_transfer_config.kv_role = kv_role
+    config = _glm5_next_mtp_kv_cache_config()
+    return moriio_connector.MoRIIOConnectorScheduler(vllm_config, "engine", config)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("restore_moriio_role")
+def test_scheduler_accepts_glm5_next_groups_with_mtp():
+    """Several attention groups (MLA + indexer, kpool tail) plus KDA, with MTP."""
+    scheduler = _glm5_next_mtp_scheduler()
+    groups = scheduler.kv_cache_config.transfer_groups
+
+    assert all(isinstance(g.kv_cache_spec, UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs) for g in groups)
+    # The MTP layer shares the target's MLA and tail groups.
+    assert {"layers.6.attn", "layers.6.indexer"} <= set(groups[1].layer_names)
+    assert "layers.6.tail" in groups[2].layer_names
+    assert scheduler._attn_group_ids == [1, 2]
+    assert scheduler._mamba_group_ids == [0]
+    assert scheduler._attn_group_is_state == [False, True]
+    assert scheduler.blocks_per_sw == [0, 0, 0]
+    assert scheduler._num_ssm_scratch_blocks == 1
+    # 1 recomputed token + 1 padded spec row + 1 drafter lookahead slot.
+    assert scheduler._max_decode_tail_blocks == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("restore_moriio_role")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("external_tokens", [0, 1500])
+def test_glm5_next_mtp_read_pairs_every_group(external_tokens):
+    """P payload -> D alignment -> zeroing filter across all transfer groups."""
+    producer = _glm5_next_mtp_scheduler("kv_producer")
+    p_request = SimpleNamespace(
+        request_id="req",
+        kv_transfer_params={"do_remote_decode": True, "transfer_id": "tx"},
+        status=RequestStatus.FINISHED_LENGTH_CAPPED,
+    )
+    # KDA group: [running state, MTP scratch slot].
+    p_blocks = ([90, 91], [10, 11], [50])
+    delay_free, p_params = _FakeConnector(producer).request_finished_all_groups(
+        p_request, p_blocks
+    )
+    assert delay_free is True
+    assert p_params["remote_block_ids"] == [[10, 11], [50], [90]]
+
+    consumer = _glm5_next_mtp_scheduler()
+    d_request = _make_read_request(p_params["remote_block_ids"])
+    # The decode's MLA group holds one extra local block for the spec tail.
+    d_blocks = _FakeBlocks(([200, 201], [100, 101, 102], [300]))
+    consumer.update_state_after_alloc(
+        d_request, d_blocks, num_external_tokens=external_tokens
+    )
+
+    local = consumer._reqs_need_recv["req"][1]
+    if external_tokens:
+        assert local == [[100, 101], [300], [200]]
+        assert consumer._req_kv_params["req"]["remote_block_ids"] == [
+            [10, 11],
+            [50],
+            [90],
+        ]
+    else:
+        # A full local MLA hit still reads the kpool tail ring and KDA state.
+        assert local == [[], [300], [200]]
+
+    output = SchedulerOutput.make_empty()
+    output.new_block_ids_to_zero = [100, 101, 102, 300]
+    consumer.build_connector_meta(output)
+    expected_zero = [102] if external_tokens else [100, 101, 102]
+    assert output.new_block_ids_to_zero == expected_zero
+
+
+def test_read_blocks_routes_each_hybrid_layer_to_its_group():
+    offsets: dict[str, tuple[list[int], list[int]]] = {}
+    worker = _FakeWorker(
+        mode=MoRIIOMode.READ,
+        world_size=1,
+        _has_mamba=True,
+        _num_attn_transfer_groups=2,
+        _num_mamba_transfer_groups=1,
+        _hybrid_payload_index_by_layer={"mla.0": 0, "tail.0": 1, "kda.0": 2},
+        layer_name_to_local_kv_cache_metadata={"mla.0": 0, "tail.0": 0, "kda.0": 0},
